newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Communications cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Communications cut.

text.p: - ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said it has downgraded American Communications Services Inc to a hold from a buy. American Communications provides competitive local telephone service in the southern United States and has begun to offer high-speed data services.

- In a release dated January 8, the brokerage said the company is in a state of flux with the resignation of Richard Kozak, who was previously president and chief executive officer and most recently served as acting chief financial officer.
"Even with capable new management joining the firm, precious time has been lost in the organization to achieve speed to market in both network build and marketing," the firm said in the release.
- Shares of American Communications traded up 1/4 at 10.
